seoTitle: PWM Calculator: Duty Cycle, Frequency, Average Voltage
metaDescription: Convert between PWM frequency, period, duty cycle and on-time, see average and RMS voltage and the timer counts for a given clock and prescaler.
intro: Work out PWM settings for LEDs, motors and servos.
why:
Enter frequency, duty cycle, supply voltage and optionally the timer clock and resolution. The page gives the period, on and off times, average voltage and RMS voltage, and a prescaler table showing the counts per period and the compare value for each prescaler, marking which fit in the counter.

Average voltage is what a filtered or resistive load sees; LEDs follow average current and motors follow the average. Audible-frequency PWM may produce noise.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter the timer clock and bit width if you want register values.
Set the compare register to the shown value.
